title: Choo-choo train, Skippy Core's coder in one call (fails to run)
model: Skippy Core's coder (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MTP, Q8), one call with MineBench's own prompt, the way MineBench runs a model
verdict: A failed build, kept. The fastest reply of all (94 seconds, 6,595 tokens), and it fails like the chat model, its sibling: MineBench gives the code block(), box(), line(), rng() and Math, but it redefines block() and box() on top of a voxel() function that does not exist, so the code stops at the first block and MineBench would score no build. Both Qwen3.6 models invent the same missing voxel call; one try, as in MineBench itself.

models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Skippy Core's coder slot: MTP, Q8_0)
